scope: React in JSDOM with deferred injected responses, no browser, live session or database.

results.name: An unrecognized JSON 400/413/422 never clears a possibly committed submission
A validation error after an ambiguous prior send preserves the original identifier
A deleted request becomes terminal and can be cleared explicitly without being recreated
A failure before POST leaves a new brief editable instead of freezing an unsent request
Rapid repeated submission enters one in-flight operation and creates one request identifier
An administrator cannot write dossier A while a selection of dossier B is pending
An expired uncertain attempt retains a minimal recovery notice before any fresh submission
